privacidad.entradilla: This policy explains what personal data we collect on tecnosport.co, what we use it for, who we share it with, and how you can exercise your rights. It is written in accordance with Colombian Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 and its implementing decrees.

parrafos: Controller: Cristhian Yurday Pérez Hoyos, sole trader, operating under the trade name Tecno Sport.
Address: Carrera 26C # 38B-31, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia.
Email for exercising your rights: contacto@tecnosport.co.
Phone and WhatsApp: +57 313 881 6711.
This policy applies to the personal data of anyone who visits tecnosport.co, creates an account, places an order, or contacts us through any of our support channels.

lista: Data subject: the natural person whose personal data is processed.
Controller: whoever decides on the database and its processing; here, Tecno Sport.
Processor: whoever processes data on the controller's behalf, such as the payment gateway or the courier.
Processing: any operation on personal data, such as collecting, storing, using, circulating, or deleting it.
Sensitive data: data affecting the data subject's privacy or whose misuse could lead to discrimination.

parrafos: Processing is governed by the principles of legality, purpose, freedom, accuracy, transparency, restricted access and circulation, security, and confidentiality. In practice: we only ask for the data we need to sell and deliver a product to you, we do not use it for purposes other than those stated here, and we do not make it available to anyone who does not need it for those same purposes.

lista: Identification and contact: name, email address, phone number, and delivery address.
Transactional: products purchased, amounts, chosen payment method, order status, and purchase history.

Identity document type and number, only if you choose to pay in instalments with Sistecrédito: it is the data they use to look up your credit limit. We send it to Sistecrédito for that purchase and we do not keep it.

Account data, if you choose to create one: email and password, which is stored using a one-way hash and never in plain text. If you create it or sign in with your Google account, there is no password: Google gives us your email, confirmation that it is verified, and an identifier for your Google account. We never receive your Google password.
Technical: IP address and the date and time of relevant actions, such as granting this authorisation or sign-in attempts.
Browsing: only what is strictly necessary for the site to work. See the cookie policy.
From the conversation, if you message us on WhatsApp: your phone number, your profile name and what you write to us, for example the product, colour or size you want.

parrafos: We do not store card numbers or financial data. Payments by credit or debit card, PSE and the Bancolombia button are processed entirely on the Wompi payment gateway platform, and that data never passes through our servers. If you choose to pay in instalments with Sistecrédito, the credit is assessed and granted by Sistecrédito on its own platform: we send them your identity document type and number and your order details, and we do not keep the document. When you pay by transfer to our Nequi, Daviplata or BBVA accounts, the payment does not go through any gateway: you send us the receipt and a person checks it. That receipt shows us the name of the account holder you transfer from, the institution and the amount, and we use it only to confirm your payment; we do not store it in our systems - only your order reference and the confirmation that the payment arrived remain.
We process your data in order to:
lista: Process, confirm, and ship your order, quote the shipping cost using your destination city, generate the shipping label, and keep you informed of the shipment status.
Check whether cash on delivery is available in your city and coordinate the delivery.
Handle requests, complaints, claims, warranties, and withdrawal requests.

Answer your enquiries on WhatsApp, including confirming with our supplier whether the colour of a technology device or the size of a pair of shoes you want is available and sending you the link to buy it. We do not give the supplier your data to ask: only the product, the colour and the size.
Comply with legal, accounting, and tax obligations.
Prevent fraud and protect account security.
Manage your account, if you choose to create one.
cierre: We do not send marketing communications or advertising using this data. If we ever decide to, we would ask for a separate, specific authorisation, which you could refuse without it affecting your purchase.

parrafos: In order to sell and deliver, we share strictly necessary data with:
lista: Wompi (Bancolombia S.A.), as payment gateway, to process and confirm the payment.

Sistecrédito, as the credit provider, only if you choose to pay in instalments with them: they receive your identity document type and number, your order number, and the amount to be financed. Sistecrédito assesses and grants the credit under its own data processing policy and its own contract with you.
Google Cloud Platform, as the infrastructure provider hosting the application and the database.

Google, only if you choose to create your account or sign in with your Google account: Google confirms your identity and gives us the data in section 5. We do not send Google any of your data, but when you open the sign-in and create-account pages your browser loads the Google button from Google's servers, and Google processes what it receives under its own privacy policy.

Skydropx S.A.S., a Colombian company with tax ID (NIT) 901.508.804-5 and registered office in Bogotá D.C., as our logistics and shipping platform, and the carrier companies it engages to deliver your order; they receive your name, phone number, delivery address and city, and the amount to be collected when you pay on delivery.
Resend, as our transactional email provider, to send you account verification, password recovery, and order status emails.

WhatsApp LLC, as messaging service, only if you message us on WhatsApp: the conversation goes through its servers, and WhatsApp processes what it receives under its own terms and its own privacy policy.
cierre: We do not sell, rent, or transfer personal data to third parties for those third parties' own purposes.

parrafos: Our infrastructure relies on cloud computing services that may store or process information on servers located outside Colombia; this includes our infrastructure provider, our transactional email provider, and the WhatsApp messaging service when you message us there. The logistics and shipping platform we contract with is a Colombian company, and its own data processing policy contemplates the transmission and transfer of data, both domestic and international. Those transmissions take place under contract with each provider and solely to deliver the service described in this policy.
We neither request nor process sensitive data. Our products are not aimed at minors and we do not knowingly collect minors' data; if we find that an account belongs to a minor, we will delete it.
As a data subject you have the right to:
lista: Access, update, and correct your data.
Request proof of the authorisation you granted.
Be informed about how your data has been used.
File complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce for breaches of the law.
Withdraw your authorisation or request deletion of your data, where no legal or contractual duty prevents it.
Access your data free of charge.

parrafos: Write to contacto@tecnosport.co from the email address you used to buy, stating your name, the order concerned, and what you are asking for.

We answer enquiries within a maximum of ten (10) business days, extendable by five (5) more business days where we cannot answer within that time. Claims are handled within a maximum of fifteen (15) business days, extendable by eight (8) more. In both cases we will tell you about the extension and its reasons before the initial deadline expires.

We keep your order and payment data for as long as Colombian accounting and tax obligations require, and the data needed to handle warranties for as long as the product's warranty term runs. Abandoned shopping carts are deleted automatically after thirty (30) days without activity. Once those periods end, data is deleted or anonymised.

We apply reasonable technical and administrative measures: the site is served over an encrypted connection, passwords are stored using a one-way hash, administrative access requires role-based authentication, and there are attempt limits to hinder automated attacks. No measure removes risk entirely, and we do not promise absolute security.

You may withdraw your authorisation at any time. Deletion does not apply where there is a legal or contractual duty to keep the data: for example, information about an already paid purchase must be kept for the period imposed by tax law, even if you withdraw your authorisation for other purposes.

This policy is in force from the version date shown at the top of this document. The databases will remain active for as long as the business operates and for the statutory retention periods thereafter. Any substantial change will be published on this same page with a new version date.

terminos.entradilla: These terms govern the purchase of products on tecnosport.co. By confirming an order you accept this document as it stands on that day.

parrafos: Seller: Cristhian Yurday Pérez Hoyos, sole trader, trading as Tecno Sport.
Tax ID (NIT): 1054994043-9. Address: Carrera 26C # 38B-31, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia.
Contact: contacto@tecnosport.co and +57 313 881 6711 (phone and WhatsApp).

This document governs the retail sale, through tecnosport.co and with delivery within Colombia, of casual and sports clothing, footwear, bags, and technology products (including mobile phones, smartwatches, headphones, video game consoles, speakers, computers, tablets and projectors). The contract is formed when we confirm your order, not when you click buy: until then we verify the price and the actual availability of each product.

You can buy without registering, providing only your email and delivery details. If you create an account, you are responsible for the accuracy of your data and for keeping your password confidential. We may suspend an account where we detect fraudulent use.

Photographs of clothing, footwear, and bags show the product we sell, taken by us or by the supplier who provides it. Technology photographs are reference images of the model, taken from information published by the brand or by a product-data catalogue, and not of the unit you receive: the model, memory, and other features are those stated on the product page, and the colour is the one you choose there, even if the photo shows another. Below the photos of each device we list the colours in which the manufacturer publishes that model: that does not mean we have all of them. Images are to-scale representations of the actual product; colour may vary slightly depending on your screen.

All prices are shown in Colombian pesos (COP) and are the final price of each product: Tecno Sport is not a VAT (IVA) taxpayer in Colombia, so no tax is added to the published price. The price of each product does not include the shipping cost: that amount depends on the destination city and on the size and weight of your order, and is calculated at the time of purchase. If you pick the order up at our Medellín location (section 8), there is no shipping cost. The published price of each product is the most you pay for it. If you pay by bank transfer, at pickup at our location or cash on delivery, it also carries a discount (section 6). Before you pay, we show you the full breakdown: the price of each product, the subtotal, the discount that applies to the payment method you chose, the shipping cost listed separately, and the total you will pay.

If an obvious system or typing error shows a product at a manifestly wrong price, we will tell you before shipping and you may either confirm the purchase at the correct price or cancel it at no cost.
Check the use and care restrictions on each product page; for footwear and clothing, use other than intended may affect the warranty.

Stock is verified at the moment the order is created. If a product becomes unavailable after your purchase, we will tell you immediately so you can decide whether to wait for a new date or prefer a refund, which will be made within fifteen (15) calendar days.

Some products depend on what our supplier has, and we confirm their availability before selling them: for technology, the colour of each device; for footwear, the size of each model. When the product page says that we confirm the colour or the size before you buy it, that product cannot be added to the cart: the button takes you to message us on WhatsApp, we ask the supplier and reply through the same channel. Asking for confirmation does not oblige you to buy.

If the colour or the size is available, we send you a purchase link. It is good for a single purchase, keeps one unit reserved while it is valid, and expires on the date and time we give you with it; if it expires without a purchase, the unit is no longer reserved and you can message us again. Anyone who has the link can use it, so do not share it. If it is not available, we tell you and let you know which colours or sizes are: the colour and size of your purchase are always the ones you accept, and we never change them without asking you.

We accept credit and debit cards, PSE and the Bancolombia button, processed by the Wompi payment gateway; transfers to our Nequi, Daviplata or BBVA accounts, which we check by hand against the receipt you send us; instalment payments with Sistecrédito; cash on delivery, where enabled for your city and your order; and pay at pickup, in cash or by transfer, when you pick the order up at our Medellín location (section 8). The payment methods available for your order are the ones we show you at checkout: not all of them are enabled for every order. When you pay by transfer, your order is held for 24 hours: if we do not receive the receipt within that time, the hold is released and the order is cancelled. We do not store card data: that information is handled entirely on the gateway's platform.

Payment method discount. If you pay by transfer to our accounts, at pickup at our location or cash on delivery, each product carries a discount on its published price. You can see the discount for each product on its page, in the cart and before you pay, and it is shown on your purchase receipt. The discount does not apply when you pay by card, PSE or the Bancolombia button through Wompi, or with Sistecrédito: in those cases you pay the published price. It does not apply to the shipping cost either. The discount is in force for as long as it appears in these terms; if we withdraw it, we will announce it on this site, and purchases made before keep the discount they were made with.

When you choose to pay at pickup, we call you or message you on WhatsApp to confirm the order before preparing it. If we cannot confirm it within forty-eight (48) hours of the purchase, we cancel it and release the products, at no charge. You pay the total, with the payment method discount, at our location when you receive the order.

For every purchase we email you a receipt, to the address you gave us, with the detail of what you bought, what you paid, and how we deliver it. Keep it: it is the proof of your purchase and what you need to claim the warranty. That receipt is not a sales invoice: Tecno Sport is not a VAT (IVA) taxpayer and is not required to issue invoices, under article 1.6.1.4.3 of Decree 1625 of 2016.

Whether cash on delivery is available is decided by the system based on the delivery city, the order value, and the product type, and you are told before choosing a payment method. When you pay on delivery, the amount the carrier collects is the order total, that is, the goods with the payment method discount (section 6) plus the shipping cost, and carriers only accept cash, so please have the exact amount ready. Refusing delivery is not the same as withdrawing: it is a purchase that was never completed, and in that case there is no money to refund because none was received. Repeatedly refusing deliveries may lead us not to enable this method on later purchases.

Before shipping a cash-on-delivery order we call you or message you on WhatsApp to confirm it. If we cannot confirm it within forty-eight (48) hours of the purchase, we cancel it and release the products, at no charge.

We ship nationwide through carrier companies. You can also pick up your order at no cost at our location (Carrera 26C # 38B-31, apartment 401, La Milagrosa neighbourhood, Medellín) when every product in the order comes from our Medellín suppliers. Before you pay we show you whether your order can be picked up: if a single product comes from another supplier, that order is delivered to your address.

The shipping cost is calculated using the destination city you give us and the weight and dimensions of your order. We show it to you before you pay, as an amount separate from the price of the products. If no carrier covers the address you provided, or if a product in your order cannot be delivered to your address, we will tell you at that moment, before you pay: that order cannot be placed on this site, and you may message us on WhatsApp to look for another way to deliver it.

We do not agree with you on a delivery term other than the statutory one, so the term of thirty (30) calendar days from payment confirmation or, if you pay on receipt, from the day you place the order applies. If we announce a shorter term for a specific order, that announced term is the one that binds us. The estimated date shown by the carrier at the time of purchase is its own estimate, not a term different from the one stated here.

When we ship an order to your address we will send you an email with the carrier company handling it and the tracking number, along with a link where you can check your order status whenever you want. Tracking the package on its way is done by the carrier company using that tracking number; we do not display it on this site.

If you choose pickup, we email you when the order is ready at our location. It is an apartment, not a shop, so we agree with you on a time for the handover by WhatsApp or email, any day between 8:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m.

We hand the order over to whoever shows us its order number, which appears in the purchase confirmation email and in the notice that it is ready. Do not share it with anyone you do not want to pick it up.

From the notice that it is ready we hold the order for forty-eight (48) hours. If you do not pick it up within that time, we cancel the order and release the products: if you had already paid, we refund everything you paid within the following fifteen (15) calendar days, through the method you paid with; if you were going to pay at pickup, there is nothing to refund.
The day you receive the order at our location is the delivery date: the five (5) business days of the right of withdrawal (section 9) and the one-year legal warranty (section 10) run from then.
If we do not deliver within the applicable term, you may terminate the contract and recover your money, including any shipping cost you paid.
As this is a distance sale, you may withdraw within five (5) business days following delivery of the product, without having to explain why.
To exercise it, write to contacto@tecnosport.co within that period, return the product in the same condition in which you received it, and give us the details we need for the refund.

We refund your money within fifteen (15) calendar days following the day both of the conditions above are met: that you have returned the product and that you have given us the details the refund needs. That is how article 47 of Law 1480 of 2011, as amended by Law 2439 of 2024, counts that period. We refund through the payment method you prefer: tell us when you withdraw or when you send us your details, and that is the one we use. That period covers everyone involved, including the financial institution.

The cost of return shipping is borne by you, as provided in article 47 of Law 1480 of 2011. What we refund is everything you paid for the purchase, including the shipping cost we charged you at checkout. The costs of returning your money, including any financial costs, are borne by us.
Withdrawal does not apply to products made or personalised to your specifications, nor to the other cases excluded by article 47 of Law 1480 of 2011.

All our products carry the statutory warranty: if the product fails, does not work for what it was offered for, or does not match what you bought, you are entitled to have it repaired, replaced, or refunded, as applicable.

The legal warranty term is one (1) year from delivery, unless the producer announces a longer one, in which case the longer term applies. That one-year term applies to every new product we sell, technology devices included: there is no separate warranty regime for phones, computers, consoles, tablets or anything else.
Claiming the warranty costs you nothing: repair, and shipping the product for repair, are on us, as provided in article 11 of Law 1480 of 2011.

The warranty does not cover damage arising from force majeure or a fortuitous event, from the act of a third party, from improper use of the product (including unauthorised modification) or from failure to follow the installation, use or maintenance instructions where the product was supplied with a manual in Spanish. These are the grounds listed in article 16 of Law 1480 of 2011, and proving that the damage arises from one of them is on us, not on you.
To claim it, write to contacto@tecnosport.co with your order number and a description of the problem.

Payment reversal is different from withdrawal. It applies where you were a victim of fraud, where the product was not delivered, where it does not match what you ordered, or where it is defective. You must request it both from us and from the issuer of your payment method within five (5) business days of learning of the event, and we will facilitate the process.
Channels for guidance, assistance, and filing requests, complaints, and claims: contacto@tecnosport.co and WhatsApp +57 313 881 6711.
Our channels are available every day, from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Colombian time. The same hours apply to our social media.

We answer your requests, complaints, and claims within a maximum of fifteen (15) business days. Requests about your personal data (enquiries and claims) have their own deadlines, shorter in the case of an enquiry, and they are set out in section 12 of our personal data processing policy.

The content of tecnosport.co is protected by intellectual property law. Photographs and product data sheets that we did not take or write ourselves (those of our suppliers, of the brands, and of product-data catalogues) belong to their owners. You may use the content to inform yourself and to buy, but not reproduce it for commercial purposes without the written authorisation of whoever holds the rights.
You may not use the site for fraudulent activity, attempt to access other people's accounts, interfere with the platform's operation, or extract its content in bulk.

We are liable for performance of the contract and for the statutory warranty on the terms imposed by Colombian law, which are matters of public policy and cannot be waived. We are not liable for failures attributable to force majeure, nor for your use of the product in conditions other than those intended.
Processing of your data is governed by our personal data processing policy, available in the corresponding section of this site.
We may amend these terms. Changes are published on this page with a new version date, and your purchase is governed by the version in force on the day you made it.

These terms are governed by Colombian law. You may bring your claims to us through the channels indicated and, if you are not satisfied, to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce, which holds judicial powers in consumer protection matters. Nothing in this document limits the actions the law grants you.
The version shown at the top of this document, with its date, is the one in force. Your purchase is governed by the version in force on the day you made it.

cookies.entradilla: This page explains which cookies tecnosport.co uses and what for. Colombia has no cookie-specific statute: what applies is the personal data protection regime where a cookie processes personal data, together with the general duty to inform you clearly.

parrafos: A cookie is a small file a site stores in your browser to remember something between one page and the next. We also use the browser's local storage, which works in a similar way.
Today tecnosport.co uses only what is strictly necessary to work:
lista: Refresh session cookie: created only if you sign in, it keeps your session open without retyping your password, and lasts thirty (30) days. It is accessible only to the server.
Theme preference: remembers whether you chose light mode, dark mode, or the system setting.
Reduced motion preference: remembers whether you asked to reduce animations.
Cart identifier: stored in the browser's local storage so your cart is still there if you close the tab. It does not identify a person on its own.
Language: taken from the page address, not from a cookie.

Google button: on the sign-in and create-account pages, your browser loads the Google button from Google's servers, and Google may use its own cookies there under its policy. We neither read nor use them.

parrafos: We use no analytics, advertising, profiling, or remarketing cookies, and there are no third-party cookies for those purposes. That is why this site shows no cookie consent banner: there is nothing to consent to beyond what is needed to make it work. If we ever add analytics or advertising, we will ask for your prior consent with a refuse option as easy as the accept one, and we will update this page before doing so.
You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Bear in mind that if you block the necessary ones, you will not be able to stay signed in and your cart may empty when you close the tab.
The version shown at the top of this document, with its date, is the one in force. Any change is published on this same page with a new version date.
